name: Hôtel Tamaris
notes: Small independent "hôtel de charme" (~35 rooms) in Mahrès. Own website exists but is outdated (copyright 2018) and has NO booking engine despite a book button — bookings likely via phone. Good prospect for an online booking solution.

name: Dar El Mahdia (by Daldoul)
notes: Charming family-run maison d'hôtes with pool near Corniche beach. No own website found — only Booking.com, Agoda, TripAdvisor, and a thin Instagram (3k followers, 14 posts) plus a Facebook page. Strong prospect for an online booking solution.

name: Dar Khouadja
notes: Tiny 2-suite luxury guesthouse in Mahdia medina. Facebook and Instagram are its only real channels; the domain listed on its Facebook (dar-khouadja.com) does not resolve, so it effectively has no working website. Relies on Booking.com and Airbnb for direct bookings. Strong prospect for a simple online booking site.

name: Dar Baya
booking_engine: none detected (has a 'book' button but no real booking engine)
notes: Charming 18-bed boutique hotel in the Sfax medina with its own modern, mobile-friendly website (https://www.dar-baya.com) but NO real booking engine (only a 'book' button, no OTA links). Active on Facebook and Instagram. Good prospect for an online booking solution.

name: Dar Jbel Hammamet
notes: Independent maison d'hôtes / gîte rural, ~15 min from Hammamet. Wix site with a "book a room" page but no real booking engine — reservations via phone or email only. Listed on Booking.com. Good prospect for an online booking solution.

name: Misk Villa - Boutique Hotel & Spa
notes: Independent boutique hotel & spa in Sidi Bou Saïd with ~10 rooms. Has a modern, mobile-friendly own website (miskvilla.com) but NO booking engine or book button — guests are directed to phone/email or Booking.com. Strong prospect for a direct online booking solution.

name: Dar Ben Gacem Kahia
notes: Independent boutique guesthouse (8 rooms in Dar Kahia, 15 total across Dar Pasha) in the Medina of Tunis. Own modern website (HTTPS, mobile-responsive) but NO embedded booking engine — bookings go via phone/WhatsApp/email and OTA listings (Booking.com, Agoda, TripAdvisor). Strong prospect for a direct online booking solution.

name: La Villa Bleue
notes: Independent 5-star boutique hotel with a modern, well-maintained website (2026 copyright, mobile viewport, HTTPS) that already features a "Secure Hotel Booking" engine. Also listed on Booking.com, Hotels.com, Expedia, and Agoda. Strong digital presence — likely not a high-priority prospect for a new booking solution.
